requirement.original: 将plan/review command的github Pages加一个并行的本地html部署。我通过cloudflare挂在了life-ai.app域名。现在开始加入新的sub page：travel.life-ai.app。并且每一次运行command使用deploy脚本的时候自动部署更新
requirement.clarified: Add parallel local HTML deployment alongside GitHub Pages. Create travel-web.service on port 8094 serving /var/www/travel/. Modify deploy-travel-plans.sh to copy HTML files to /var/www/travel/ in addition to GitHub Pages push. User will configure travel.life-ai.app → localhost:8094 in Cloudflare tunnel dashboard.
requirement.what: Add local static file serving for travel plans via systemd + python http.server, parallel to existing GitHub Pages deployment
requirement.why: Enable faster deployment via Cloudflare tunnel (travel.life-ai.app) without waiting for GitHub Pages build

included: Modify deploy-travel-plans.sh to add local deployment step
Modify generate-and-deploy.sh to show local URL
Ensure plan.md and review.md auto-deploy via existing generate-and-deploy.sh call
excluded: Cloudflare tunnel configuration (user handles in dashboard)
Modifying plan.md or review.md commands (they already call generate-and-deploy.sh)

success_criteria: deploy-travel-plans.sh copies HTML to /var/www/travel/{destination-slug}/{date}/index.html AND generates local index.html
generate-and-deploy.sh shows both GitHub Pages URL and local travel.life-ai.app URL
Running /plan or /review triggers both deployments automatically
constraints: Must not break existing GitHub Pages deployment
Follow same pattern as knowledge-web.service (systemd + python http.server)
No Docker, nginx, or external dependencies

root_cause_analysis.symptom: No local deployment exists - only GitHub Pages (slow, requires git push)
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: deploy-travel-plans.sh was designed for GitHub Pages only, no local serving capability
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - new feature, not a bug fix
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original design only considered GitHub Pages as deployment target
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: GitHub Pages has 1-2 min build delay; local serving via Cloudflare tunnel is instant

infrastructure_pattern.service_template:
[Unit]
Description={Name} Static File Server
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server {PORT} --directory {DIRECTORY}
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
infrastructure_pattern.cloudflared: Docker container 'cloudflared-lifeai' using token-based tunnel. Routes configured in Cloudflare Dashboard.

deploy_script_structure.deploy-travel-plans.sh: 542 lines. Takes HTML file path as arg. Steps: detect user → auth → check repo → clone gh-pages → create dir structure {dest-slug}/{date}/index.html → generate index.html → commit → push → enable Pages. Uses temp dir with trap cleanup.
deploy_script_structure.generate-and-deploy.sh: 146 lines. Takes plan-id arg. Steps: fetch images → generate HTML → validate → deploy (calls deploy-travel-plans.sh) → auto-enable Pages.

file_contents.knowledge-web.service:
[Unit]
Description=Knowledge Graph Static File Server
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8092 --directory /var/www/knowledge
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

development_approach.strategy: 1) Create systemd service + directory. 2) Add local deploy function to deploy-travel-plans.sh that mirrors the GitHub Pages directory structure into /var/www/travel/. 3) Update generate-and-deploy.sh to display local URL.
files_to_modify: scripts/deploy-travel-plans.sh - add local deployment step after GitHub Pages push
scripts/generate-and-deploy.sh - add local URL in output
development_approach.validation_approach: 1) Verify travel-web.service is active. 2) Run deploy-travel-plans.sh with existing HTML. 3) Verify files exist in /var/www/travel/. 4) Curl localhost:8094 to verify serving.
